campaign_hot_path_git_hang.problem: _resolve_source_commit shelled out to `git rev-parse HEAD` on the hot path of every astra_campaign_* call before touching disk; that subprocess could wedge indefinitely (a git rev-parse HEAD was found stuck 30+ min despite timeout=10), hanging astra_campaign_start AND the read-only astra_campaign_list for the full 1800s client timeout. Distinct from the 2026-08-21 concurrency fix: here each call hangs itself, not others.
campaign_hot_path_git_hang.fix: Removed the subprocess from the hot path. Pure-Python _read_head_commit/_git_dir resolve HEAD by reading git ref files directly (HEAD -> loose ref -> packed-refs; handles detached HEAD, .git-file worktree form, commondir). _resolve_source_commit order: explicit -> ASTRA_SOURCE_COMMIT env -> direct read -> hardened last-resort git subprocess (stdin=DEVNULL, no prompt, timeout=5) never reached in a normal checkout.
campaign_hot_path_git_hang.verification: Direct reader matches `git rev-parse HEAD` in ~1.3ms; real start+list roundtrip in 18ms+2ms with zero subprocess spawns (spy-verified). tests/test_campaign_api_no_git_subprocess.py: 10 new tests.
campaign_hot_path_git_hang.hardening_sweep: Consolidated HEAD resolution into core/git_head.py and routed all three local provenance callers through it (campaign_api, client_validation, external_benchmarks); dropped their now-unused subprocess imports. The two remaining `git rev-parse HEAD` (external_evaluators.py:521, formal_validators.py:250) run inside base64'd remote-script strings on a udocker/Lean-remote container, not the MCP server process, so they cannot hang it. New tests/test_git_head_callers.py (4 tests).
campaign_hot_path_git_hang.process_hygiene: Terminated the wedged orphan git rev-parse HEAD (PID 29800). The venv+Python312 process pair per server is by design (re-exec into the 3.12 SDK), not duplicate servers; killing the venv parent takes the child with it. On 2026-08-22 killed all three live ASTRA-2.0 server pairs (current + two prior-session orphans); the client respawned a single clean pair (42136->35552) running the fixed code.
